name: False Brethren
overview: Scripture warns believers to be vigilant against false brethren who cause divisions and oppose sound doctrine, urging the church to mark and avoid such individuals. The call to reject heretics after admonition emphasizes the seriousness of preserving doctrinal purity. Believers are reminded to offer themselves as living sacrifices to God, maintaining holiness and discernment, while understanding that persistent falsehood and rebellion against God’s truth lead to eternal judgment.
